scope: Real TestSet training/WP QA artifact and numerical-contract audit; no physics validation or downstream rerun

yield_pol0.method: ROOT TGraphErrors weighted TF1 pol0 fit
yield_pol0.reference_difference: preserves every valid efficiency point; avoids TH1 bin collisions overwriting scan points
yield_pol0.uncertainty: marginal mass-fit errors; covariance between nested WP samples unavailable

spectrum_qa_pol0.method: ROOT TGraphErrors weighted TF1 pol0 fit
spectrum_qa_pol0.reference_difference: preserves every valid efficiency point; avoids TH1 bin collisions overwriting scan points
spectrum_qa_pol0.uncertainty: marginal mass-fit errors; covariance between nested WP samples unavailable

mc_range_selection.bounds: inclusive at both ends; rows removed, surviving values unchanged
mc_range_selection.efficiency_scope: conditional on the same frozen MC feature ranges applied to all domains
mc_range_selection.shape_policy: range selection only; no distribution matching, reweighting or Winsorization

reference.source: bounded selected finite-feature reconstructed MC signal sample
reference.group_definition: source file/tree and PV surrogate; not a producer collision ID

limitations: Finite reference quantiles do not guarantee a full-population coverage fraction.
A rectangular feature range does not enforce a joint-density or shape match.
The MC-derived preselection acceptance needs independent MC for a final physical efficiency.

signal.upstream_count_scope: native ROOT truth/kinematic filters precede sampler; unknown for prepared tables
signal.priority_sampling: uniform per-row random priorities; retain max_per_class smallest priorities
